analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of coder.com/docs covered 820 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.08% overall confidence. Critical issue: 94 confirmed broken internal links exist within user-facing documentation. API reference coverage is 75% with 276 API pages detected. Freshness metadata is visible on only 38.29% of pages, limiting maintainability transparency. SEO/GEO issues affect 16.83% of content.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved: 820 of 821 discovered pages indexed (100%)
High overall audit confidence at 91.08% with strong link verification confidence at 93.95%
API documentation present and detected across 276 pages with 75% reference coverage
Example code reliability estimated at 88.62%, indicating generally trustworthy samples
No repository navigation link breakage (0 repo_broken_links_count)
risks: 94 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation create poor user experience and erode trust
38.29% freshness coverage means 61.71% of pages lack visible last-updated dates, obscuring content staleness
16.83% SEO/GEO issue rate may impact discoverability and search ranking
25% API reference gap leaves portion of API surface undocumented or undetected
1 unverified link due to auth/rate-limit/server blocks introduces uncertainty in link health
444 pages requested but not crawled (1265 requested vs 821 discovered) suggests potential scope or redirect issues
Multi-project topology mode may hide inconsistencies across product documentation sets

prioritized_actions.action: Repair all 94 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation
Implement last-updated metadata on remaining 61.71% of pages lacking freshness indicators
Investigate and close 25% API reference coverage gap (identify missing endpoints or improve detection)
Audit and resolve 16.83% SEO/GEO issues (meta descriptions, titles, structured data)
Investigate 444-page gap between requested and discovered pages to identify redirect chains or scope leaks

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy or correctness of technical content, code examples, or API specifications
1 unverified link due to authentication or rate-limiting means link health for protected resources is unconfirmed
API coverage detection may miss non-standard documentation patterns or dynamically generated reference pages
Freshness metadata reflects only visible last-updated dates; actual content currency requires manual review
Multi-project topology may obscure cross-project linking issues or inconsistent standards between product doc sets
